audit_scope.kind: Correctness audit; no fitting or selection authorization

findings.detail: Actual model changes and AdamW gradient moments establish encoder optimization; this conclusion does not rely on parameter enumeration.
Stable named checkpoints show continuing encoder and head optimization across intervening development evaluations. No live latest.pt or final direct result was opened.

All58 shared encoder state tensors in both final and selected frozen artifacts equal the selected parent exactly. The copied selected_encoder.pt is byte-identical to the parent. No encoder optimizer state is present; all four head parameter tensors have positive gradient second moments and step2000.

core.predict uses scoped no_grad and model.eval without changing requires_grad. Every downstream training call restores readout.train and, for full/direct modes, encoder.train with an attached encoding path. Frozen mode alone uses no_grad around encoding. Permanent requires_grad(False) occurs after training, during export. Actual full/direct optimizer advancement confirms that evaluation did not permanently stop supervised encoder optimization. CF source likewise restores selected-encoder training mode for full fine-tuning; frozen CF keeps its encoder and BN buffers in eval mode. No CF numerical execution was performed.

Every inspected supervised batch contains64 distinct indices from the admitted TRAIN supervised pool, with matching row IDs and sequence hashes. Full and direct records match for2250 steps; frozen matches their first2000 steps. All2000 historical short-probe batches match the corresponding strong-readout prefix. Source fixes the fresh head initializer at seed100007 independently of pretraining RNG and loads only ancestor encoder tensors. Downstream initial head tensors were not reconstructed with a model constructor.

Completed inference and continuation artifacts retain exactly the parent TRAIN scalers, with finite means and positive standard deviations of the expected dimensions. Source requires TRAIN role and split membership before scaler fitting, scales only observed values, trains masked five-quantile pinball and inversely scales predictions before native-dB development scoring. Sorting precedes pinball and inference. Reader targets are primary-channel observations at later intervals1/3/6, while SSL crops start at those horizons. Inference batching excludes targets and future acoustic inputs. Numeric target values, masks and saved prediction scores were not reconstructed.

Saved optimizer/scheduler counters agree with completed updates and the declared10% warmup/cosine schedule. Frozen opportunities are500/1000/1500/2000, selecting1000; full opportunities are750/1500/2250/3000, selecting1500. Saved best states, reports and earliest minimum selection agree. Exported model/head tensors exactly match the corresponding named selected checkpoints, not the final training weights.

The shared screen has6000 pretraining updates and2000 total probe updates. All62 pretraining optimizer parameter tensors have step6000 and positive gradient second moments; SIGReg global_step is6000. Its exported model/head exactly matches readout-004500-000500.pt and the saved selected best state. SharedTemporalEncoder, QueryHead and NativeTemporalModel ASTs are identical between the original85c4 source snapshot and currentb7d6 source. Historical parent bindings remain unchanged.

The shared encoder mixes channels within patch4 tokens and mean-pools contextualized valid temporal tokens into latent64. The latest observed values enter their patch, but the readout has no separate raw last-observation path. This is an inspected architecture property, not evidence that pooling caused the reported performance or an implementation defect.
